clog.text: People keep to their own circles. No one yet speaks for the whole colony.
The evenings are still quiet. Friends keep to their own circles, and no one gathers the whole colony.
Vosk-75 spoke of a dome at the meeting in the habitat: a roof of sky, and streets without suits.
The council has agreed to build a dome. Vosk-75 spoke for it first, and tonight, in the habitat, Jezero promised to build it together, since the modules are full.
Sax-42 still says not yet, but will build with the rest.
The council still meets most evenings. With the dome agreed, the talk is of smaller things.
